claims.claim_text: The asymmetric size Ramsey number of F(4,2,2) vs F(4,3,1) equals 24.
claims.support_summary: Bounded paper-level argument with explicit external and computational dependencies; see accompanying files.
assumptions: Vizing adjacency lemma and pinned 7/8-vertex critical census
claims.promotion_condition: Independently review both exact finite certificates, general reductions and source contracts; CI replay; no self-certification.

claims.claim_text: If U is an independent set of k degree-D vertices, G-U is a star forest and D>=3k, then edge-chromatic number equals D.
claims.support_summary: Bounded paper-level argument with explicit external and computational dependencies; see accompanying files.
assumptions: all apices degree D and independent
claims.promotion_condition: Separate mathematical review and, preferably, formal checking of Hall cases.

claims.claim_text: A simple edge-5-critical graph C on n vertices has 2e(C)>=4n+3.
claims.support_summary: Bounded paper-level argument with explicit external and computational dependencies; see accompanying files.
claims.promotion_condition: Not invoked by the updated 24-edge proof. Historical verification optional; use ERDOS561-DELTA5-FINITE instead.

claims.claim_text: Every simple 5-edge-critical graph with at most 17 edges has exactly seven nonisolated vertices and at least sixteen edges.
claims.support_summary: Vizing adjacency-lemma discharging proves e>=2n; complete graph6 finite enumeration of 7- and 8-vertex cases with exact five-edge-colouring backtracking; all 10 eight-vertex class-II exceptions have pendant vertices.
assumptions: complete McKay graph6 catalogues and pinned source hashes
claims.promotion_condition: Independent mathematical review of charging proof, exhaustive graph6 class coverage and colour-symmetry backtracking; no self-certification.
